summary: Regular-expression denial of service in acme-textfmt banner()
details: acme-textfmt before 1.0.1 builds the banner rule with a pattern that backtracks catastrophically when the title contains '#' followed by digits (for example 'Invoice #1001'). Every call to banner() with such a title burns CPU for seconds, so any request path that renders one is a denial-of-service vector. Fixed in 1.0.1.
